name: Element Multiple
description: Developer Form API render element (#type => 'element_multiple') for collecting an unlimited (or capped) number of values, single or composite, with AJAX add/remove, drag-and-drop sorting and cardinality.
provides_plugin_types: Render/Form element plugin (#[FormElement('element_multiple')], class Drupal\element_multiple\Element\ElementMultiple extends FormElementBase) — usable as '#type' => 'element_multiple' in any Form API array.
project_description: Element Multiple provides a single Form API render element, '#type' => 'element_multiple', that gives any custom form the multi-value 'Add another' behaviour that Drupal otherwise ties to the Field system. It renders a table of repeated inputs with AJAX add/remove operations, an 'Add N more items' button, optional drag-and-drop weight sorting, configurable cardinality and min/empty item counts. The repeated input can be a single element (e.g. a textfield) or a composite of several named sub-elements (a row of columns), and an optional #key turns the returned array into an associative keyed map. Purely developer/API facing: no admin UI, no configuration, no permissions. The implementation is heavily based on the Webform module's multiple element. Maintained by Cambrico (Pedro Cambra, Manuel Egio).
